Career Draft Grade by Manager

Total season points earned across all picks vs. total expected points for those (position, round) slots. Only 2019-2025 seasons are graded — ESPN doesn't return per-player fantasy points for 2017-2018, so picks from those years can't be scored. Managers with fewer graded picks either missed a season or joined mid-history.
ManagerGraded Picks Actual PtsExpected Pts Surplus% Over ExpGrade

Positional Drafting — Who Drafts Each Position Best?

Ranks managers by % over positional expectation at each position. Because expectation is (position, round)-normalized, a QB drafter isn't rewarded just for drafting QBs — they have to beat the average QB drafted at their round.
#ManagerPicks ActualExpected Surplus% Over Exp

Round Drafting — Who Wins Which Rounds?

Ranks managers by % over expectation within a round bucket. Expectation is (position, round)-normalized, so a manager can't win R1-2 just by drafting a position that scores a lot.
#ManagerPicks ActualExpected Surplus% Over Exp
